info.name: Eureka LMS — Complete Student Journey API
info.description:
# 🎓 Eureka LMS — Student Mobile App API Collection

Welcome to the complete, automated Postman test collection for **Eureka LMS (Student Experience)**.

---

## 🗺️ Student User Journey Overview
This collection takes a student from initial app installation and registration all the way to taking timed exams, submitting homework, and viewing dynamic peer ranking analytics.

### ⚡ Zero-Manual-Config Automation
Every folder in this collection automatically extracts IDs, tokens, and response fields into collection variables:
* `{{token}}` & `{{refreshToken}}` ➔ Generated on Register/Login
* `{{stageId}}`, `{{gradeLevelId}}`, `{{subjectId}}`, `{{lessonId}}` ➔ Captured from Academic Discovery
* `{{groupId}}` & `{{groupCode}}` ➔ Captured from Group Search
* `{{homeworkId}}` & `{{examId}}` ➔ Captured from Homework/Exam feeds
* `{{notificationId}}` ➔ Captured from Notifications feed

---

## 🏃 How to Run the Entire Suite
1. Ensure MySQL and backend server are running (`npm run dev`).
2. Click **Eureka LMS — Complete Student Journey API** in Postman.
3. Click **Run Collection** ➔ **Run Eureka LMS**.
4. All 28 requests will execute in sequential order with automated variable handoffs.

item.name: Step 0: System Health & Diagnostics
item.description:
## 🩺 Phase 0: System Health & Diagnostics

### 🖥️ Endpoints Covered:
* `GET /health` or `GET /api/v1/health` (Server status, database heartbeat, and timestamp)

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Verifies that the Express API server is active and responding with status 200 OK before running any other journey tests.

item.name: Step 1: Authentication & Verification
item.description:
## 🔐 Phase 1: Authentication & Account Verification

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Register Screen` (Full name, Egyptian phone `01[0125]XXXXXXXX`, email, password)
* `Email Verification OTP Screen` (6-digit code sent via SMTP)
* `Login Screen` (Returns JWT access token + refresh token)
* `Forgot Password & Reset Password Screens`

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Automatically captures `{{token}}` and `{{refreshToken}}` upon successful registration or login.
* All subsequent requests inherit `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically.

item.name: Step 2: Academic Catalogue Discovery
item.description:
## 📚 Phase 2: Academic Catalogue Discovery

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Stage & Grade Level Selector`
* `Subject Grid Screen`
* `Units & Lessons Syllabus Accordion`
* `Lesson Details & Video Player Screen`

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Queries the educational hierarchy and extracts `{{stageId}}`, `{{gradeLevelId}}`, `{{subjectId}}`, and `{{lessonId}}` into Postman variables for seamless onboarding.

item.name: Step 3: Student Onboarding & Profile
item.description:
## 👤 Phase 3: Student Onboarding & Profile Management

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Onboarding Wizard` (Select Stage, Grade Level, and enrolled subjects)
* `Student Profile Screen`
* `App Settings Screen` (Language preference `AR`/`EN`, Dark Mode, Notification toggles)

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Uses `{{stageId}}`, `{{gradeLevelId}}`, and `{{subjectId}}` collected from Step 2 to configure the student profile with zero manual typing.

item.name: Step 4: Groups & Teacher Enrollment
item.description:
## 👥 Phase 4: Teacher Groups & Enrollment

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Group Search & Explore Screen`
* `Teacher Code Preview Modal` (Displays teacher name and schedule before joining)
* `Join Group via Code / QR`
* `My Enrolled Groups Tab`

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Searches active groups, saves `{{groupId}}` and `{{groupCode}}`, and demonstrates smart re-activation for returning students.

item.name: Step 5: Home Dashboard Screen
item.description:
## 🏠 Phase 5: Home Screen Dashboard

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Main Student Dashboard` (Home Feed)
* `Next Class Countdown Banner`
* `Today's Schedule Widget`
* `Homework Deadlines & Upcoming Exams Carousel`

item.name: Step 6: Homework Journey
item.description:
## 📝 Phase 6: Homework Workflow

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Homework Feed Tabs` (Pending vs Completed)
* `Take Homework Screen` (MCQ options & Essay input)
* `Homework Scorecard & Result Screen` (Reviewed answers & Dynamic Peer Percentile)

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Automatically captures `{{homeworkId}}` from pending feed.
* Demonstrates instant auto-grading for MCQs and Arabic essay `minWords` word-counter enforcement.

item.name: 6.2 Get Homework Questions for Taking (Answers Stripped)
6.4 Get Homework Result Scorecard & Peer Percentile
Step 7: Exams & Timed Quizzes
item.description:
## ⏱️ Phase 7: Timed Exams & Live Sessions

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Exams Feed` (Available, Upcoming, Completed)
* `Exam Instructions & 4-Color Palette Screen` (🟢 Answered, 🔵 Review, 🔴 Unanswered, ⚪ Not Visited)
* `Live Exam Session` (Server-time window enforced)
* `Exam Report Card Screen` (Pass/Fail metrics, speed stats, reviewed questions)

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Captures `{{examId}}` and enforces server-time start window checks (ignoring client device clock drift).

item.name: 7.3 Start Live Exam Session (Server-Time Window Enforced)
Step 8: Notifications & Push Center
item.description:
## 🔔 Phase 8: Notification Center & Push Alerts

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Mobile Push Notifications` (Firebase Cloud Messaging integration)
* `In-App Notification Center Feed` (Filter by All / Unread)
* `Notification Details Modal` (Auto-marks notification as read)
* `Mark All as Read Action`

### ⚙️ Automation Highlights:
* Connects mobile FCM token to project `eureka-6366a` and auto-captures `{{notificationId}}`.

item.name: Step 9: Student Analytics & Performance
item.description:
## 📊 Phase 9: Student Performance Analytics & Badges

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Analytics & Progress Dashboard`
* `Homework & Exam Completion Rate Gauges`
* `Subject Strengths Breakdown` (`ممتاز`, `جيد جداً`, `بحاجة لتحسين`)
* `Dynamic Peer Ranking Badge` (`🥇 أنت ضمن أعلى 15% من الطلاب`)

item.name: Step 10: Teacher Dashboard
item.description:
## 📊 Phase 10: Teacher Dashboard & Metrics

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Teacher_Home Screen` (Consolidated metrics: total students, active groups, active exams, revenue collection %, today's class schedule, active exams list).

item.name: Step 11: Teacher Groups & Student Roster
item.description:
## 👥 Phase 11: Teacher Group Management & Student Roster

### 📱 Mobile UI Screens Covered:
* `Teacher_Group Screen` (Browse teacher groups, active student count, schedule tags)
* `Addd Group Screen` (Create study group with cover photo, capacity, default monthly price)
* `Teacher_Group_Students Screen` (Student roster with payment badge `مدفوع` / `غير مدفوع`, attendance rate)
* `Addd Student Screen` (Find-or-create student with auto credential dispatch)
* `Student Details Modal` (Attendance stats, exam scores, homework history, and payment ledger)
